title: Projected Inverse Iteration: An Eigenvalue Approach to Ground-State Computation with Neural Quantum States
summary: Deep learning offers a powerful approach to quantum many-body problems via neural network wavefunctions, but their optimization remains a severe bottleneck. Existing optimization methods, including natural gradient descent and stochastic reconfiguration, suffer from spectral gap-dependent convergence that limits their effectiveness on systems fraught with competing orders and nearly degenerate ground states, such as frustrated magnets and strongly correlated electron materials.
